map.中国手语基础词汇图示速查，按主题展示手形、手势位置与动作要领，便于听障人士交流与: A visual quick reference of basic Chinese Sign Language vocabulary, showing handshapes, positions, and movement essentials by topic, helping deaf users communicate and learners practise against reference.
map.日常交流：查“你好”（一手握拳拇指向上微动/食指指对方点头）、“谢谢”（拇指从口: Everyday communication: look up "hello" (one fist with the thumb moving up slightly, or the index finger pointing at the other person with a nod), "thank you" (the thumb bending slightly forward and down from the mouth), and "please" (palm up, motioning toward oneself) to review common greeting gestures quickly.
map.称谓学习：按“称谓”分类查看“爸爸”（拇指从嘴角外拉）、“妈妈”（小指外拉）、“: Learning forms of address: under the "forms of address" category look at "father" (thumb pulled from the corner of the mouth), "mother" (little finger pulled outward), and "friend" (both index fingers hooked together), which are the common gestures across genders.
map.数字手语：1~10 各有固定手形（一=食指、二=食中、十=双手交叉成十字），教学: Number signs: 1 to 10 each have a fixed handshape (1 = index finger, 2 = index and middle, 10 = both hands crossed into a cross); in teaching, drill them one by one under the "numbers" category.
map.：在 43 个基础词汇（问候/称谓/数字/日常/情感/时间 共 6 大类）中搜索: : Searching "mother" among the 43 basic words (6 categories: greetings, forms of address, numbers, daily life, emotions, time) matches 1 result: one hand with the little finger extended, pulled outward from the corner of the mouth (the common gesture for a female form of address). Filtering by the "forms of address" category instead shows 8 words (me, you, he/she, father, mother, grandfather, grandmother, friend).
map.手语由哪些要素构成？: What Elements Make Up Sign Language?
map.中国通用手语（CSL）由手形、位置、方向、动作与面部表情共同构成，同一手形在不同: Chinese Sign Language (CSL) is made up of handshape, position, orientation, movement, and facial expression, and the same handshape means different things in different positions or orientations; regional habits vary slightly, so learning with video or an instructor's demonstration helps.
map.本工具收录多少词汇？: How Many Words Does This Tool Include?
map.内置 43 个基础词汇，覆盖问候、称谓、数字、日常、情感、时间 6 大类，支持关: 43 basic words are built in, covering 6 categories: greetings, forms of address, numbers, daily life, emotions, and time, with keyword search and category filtering; it serves as a basic reference, and expressive ability needs systematic courses and practice.
